top_paper.title: EnvHarness: Awakening Static Worlds for Agent Learning
top_paper.summary: EnvHarness and EnvRigger dynamically reshape static environments via programmable plugins to target agent weaknesses and improve reinforcement learning co-evolution.

papers.title: FlowEvo: Self-Evolving Agents through the Co-Evolution of Workflows and Executable Skills
papers.summary: FlowEvo enables large language model agents to co-evolve reusable skills and workflows during inference, improving accuracy and efficiency across diverse benchmarks.

papers.title: TinyCast: Probabilistic Zero-Shot Forecasting with Computed Periodicity
papers.summary: TinyCast is a compact, attention-free zero-shot forecaster that uses spectral period detection and dilated convolutions to emit predictive distributions with minimal parameters and embedded-device compatibility.

papers.title: The Embedder's Dilemma: LLMs Are Better, but at What Cost?
papers.summary: Large language models and dedicated embedding models achieve nearly identical aggregate performance across diverse tasks, but embedding models are far cheaper and faster, supporting a division of labor by task type.

papers.title: τ_0-VLA: a Hierarchical Robot Foundation Model with World-Model-Guided Test-Time Computation
papers.summary: A hierarchical vision-language-action model improves long-horizon robot manipulation by using world-model-guided test-time search to scale computation for high-level subtask decisions.

papers.title: QuoteBench: How Matched Scores Can Hide Command-Path Failures
papers.summary: QuoteBench reveals that execution-boundary parsing errors significantly reduce LLM coding agent success, and disclosing the boundary helps recover performance, showing that evaluation must account for deployment configuration rather than treating matched scores as intrinsic model properties.

papers.title: Hierarchical Self-Improvement: A Framework for Task-Specific Evolvable Agent Harnesses
papers.summary: Hierarchical Self-Improvement evolves task-specific execution harnesses for frozen LLM agents via hierarchical self-modification, yielding substantial gains on moderate tasks while being bounded by feedback quality and backbone limits.

papers.title: GOAG: Generative and Object-Agnostic Grasp Planner for Dexterous Robotic Manipulation
papers.summary: GOAG is an object-agnostic deep generative grasp planner that learns a gripper-specific contact surface distribution to sample valid grasps for unseen objects without object-specific training.

papers.title: CoToGrasp: Contact-Topology-Conditioned Dexterous Grasp Synthesis via Canonical Workspace Learning
papers.summary: CoToGrasp is a generative framework that synthesizes diverse, stable grasps conditioned on specific contact topologies using an object-agnostic, gripper-centric workspace for zero-shot generalization.

papers.title: Thinking in a Low-Resource Language: What SFT Builds, What RL Fixes, What Accuracy Cannot See
papers.summary: Fine-tuning large mixture-of-experts models on a low-resource language shifts reasoning into that language without harming accuracy, while reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards fixes formatting and leakage defects.

papers.title: NARU: A Benchmark for NARrative Evolution and Cultural Nuance Understanding in Japanese Extreme Long Video
papers.summary: NARU is a Japanese long-form video benchmark evaluating narrative evolution and cultural reasoning through a hierarchical annotation pipeline and extensive native-speaker verification.

papers.title: Listening Forward: Next Patch Embedding Prediction Enables Scalable Audio Learners
papers.summary: NAPE uses causal Transformers to predict successive spectrogram patch embeddings for self-supervised audio learning without auxiliary components.

papers.title: Towards Quantifying Benchmark Optimization in ASR Models
papers.summary: High-performing speech recognition models reproduce benchmark transcripts despite contradictory audio, revealing benchmark-optimized behaviors that inflate scores without improving real-world transcription.

papers.title: SWE-bench Science: Can Coding Agents Resolve Engineering Tasks in Science?
papers.summary: SWE-bench Science benchmarks coding agents on scientific software repair, revealing failure mechanisms and mixed effects of scientific guidance.

papers.title: Chain-of-Experience for Continual LLM Improvement
papers.summary: Large language models improve continuously through iterative test-time feedback loops called Chain-of-Experience, outperforming zero-shot baselines with lower cost and higher token efficiency.

papers.title: FlashPrefill V2: Block-Sparse Prefill Attention for Long-Context LLM Serving
papers.summary: FlashPrefill V2 improves long-context serving via mean-corrected sparse attention, optimized GPU operators, and framework integration, achieving large speedups over dense baselines.

papers.title: SkillEvo: Self-Renewing Evolution Gradients from Multi-Turn Interaction Feedback
papers.summary: SkillEvo improves agent skills through multi-turn feedback and active governance to sustain evolution gradients.

papers.title: Repo0: Design-Driven Zero-to-All Code Generation
papers.summary: Repo0 uses a dual-graph architectural state and modularity-guided structural evolution to generate complete software repositories from natural-language requirements with high functionality coverage.

papers.title: Inject, Align, Recover: Staged Post-Training for Retrieval-Free Document Knowledge Internalization
papers.summary: IAR is a three-stage post-training framework that injects structured document knowledge into language models, aligns them for retrieval-free question answering, and recovers general capabilities, improving both domain accuracy and general performance.

papers.title: 4DAnyone: Create Anyone in 4D from a Casual Monocular Video
papers.summary: 4DAnyone reconstructs 4D humans from monocular video by generating multiview-consistent videos and lifting them into 4D Gaussian Splatting, using reference and target context designs to overcome scaling bottlenecks.

papers.title: MemTrapBench: Benchmarking Cognitive Traps in LLM Memory Use
papers.summary: Retrieved memories can induce reasoning errors and belief distortions in large language models, and an inference-time strategy helps avoid these cognitive traps while maintaining benchmark performance.

papers.title: ForgeWM: Progressive Causal Training for Few-Step Action-Conditioned Video World Models
papers.summary: ForgeWM progressively distills bidirectional video generators into efficient few-step interactive world models with aligned discrete and continuous controls, supporting low-latency interaction and replay-time refinement.

papers.title: WithEveryone: Unified Planning and Identity Grounding for Group Image Generation
papers.summary: WithEveryone enables reliable identity-preserving group image generation for up to ten people by grounding identities to layout plans and using region-based identity losses.

papers.title: FACET: Preserving Source Intent and Executable State in Terminal Task Synthesis
papers.summary: FACET constructs executable terminal tasks by preserving source intent and grounding instructions, solutions, and verifiers in a shared repaired environment to enable scalable agent training.

papers.title: EnvHarness: Awakening Static Worlds for Agent Learning
papers.summary: EnvHarness and EnvRigger dynamically reshape static environments via programmable plugins to target agent weaknesses and improve reinforcement learning co-evolution.

papers.title: EXIMO: VLM Guided Exploration of VLA Policies
papers.summary: EXIMO efficiently fine-tunes large vision-language-action robot policies by combining VLM-guided exploration, imitation on orchestrated data, and residual off-policy reinforcement learning.

papers.title: PolicyGuide: From Guarding One Action to Guiding the Whole Workflow for Policy-Compliant LLM Agents
papers.summary: Customer-service LLM agents must follow organizational policy when acting on a user's behalf. Compliance failures arise from either forbidden actions, such as granting an ineligible change, or omitted procedural requirements, such as identification or confirmation. Runtime safeguards can intervene on risky actions, but action-local checks do not guide an agent through a multi-step procedure. Workflow-following systems support prescribed process execution, but primarily target workflow completion rather than safeguarding agent behavior. papers.title: VA-Judger: Reward Modeling from Human Preference Feedback for Joint Video-Audio Generation
papers.summary: A human-aligned chain-of-thought reward model and preference dataset improve joint video-audio generation by replacing fragmented metrics with coherent, dimension-wise reinforcement learning.

papers.title: Evaluating Music Context Preservation: A Multi-facet Framework for Music Editing Systems
papers.summary: The study introduces MuseCPEval, a framework with tailored metrics to evaluate preservation of unchanged musical attributes during editing tasks.

papers.title: Towards Real-Time and Adaptable LiDAR Scene Completion
papers.summary: RapidLiDAR learns adaptive spatial displacements to initialize LiDAR scenes and refines them via multi-scale voxel and BEV features for real-time completion.

papers.title: SPK: Eliciting Structured Prior Knowledge for Interpretable Out-of-Distribution Detection in Real-Time Object Detection
papers.summary: Structured Prior Knowledge explicitly extracts latent semantic, geometric, and contextual priors from pretrained object detectors to detect out-of-distribution hallucinations via a compact interpretable representation.
